name: Fieldwire integration
summary: Linking a project to Fieldwire with an API key, importing Fieldwire floor plans as designs, and bringing Fieldwire tasks (punch lists) into Track3D as notes.

roles.note: The project-scoped Fieldwire pass-through checks project access but no permission string.

actions.action: Link the project to Fieldwire or replace its API key
Browse Fieldwire data for the project

nfr.statement: Delay between a task changing in Fieldwire and the matching note changing in Track3D.
nfr.open_question: The PRD says both 15 minutes and daily (INTG-REQ-017); which applies, and to which data?

requirements.title: Link a project to Fieldwire with an API key
requirements.statement: In Project settings, Integrations, a user links the project to Fieldwire by entering a Fieldwire API key. If the key is invalid or has expired, the user is told and asked to enter it again.
open_checks: How users learn that a saved key has expired is an open PRD question

acceptance_criteria.given: An admin in Project settings, Integrations
acceptance_criteria.then: They are asked for an API key and the project connects with it

acceptance_criteria.given: A project whose saved Fieldwire key has become invalid
acceptance_criteria.then: The user is told and asked to enter a new key

requirements.title: Import Fieldwire floor plans as designs, with their tasks
requirements.statement: From Project settings, Hierarchy & Designs, a user can list the Fieldwire floor plans for the linked project, pick one and import it as a design, optionally with its tasks placed at their positions. If the floor plan later changes in Fieldwire, project admins are notified by email but the Track3D design is not updated.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Fieldwire integration (t3d-prd-agent prd-organised)
sources.at: FR-003, FR-011, FR-012, AC-003, AC-004, AC-007, AC-008, EC-008, Out of Scope (automatic design updates)

open_checks: Procore and Autodesk designs do update automatically (INTG-REQ-011); product to say whether the platforms should behave the same (DEC-050)

acceptance_criteria.when: An admin chooses Add designs, Import from Fieldwire
acceptance_criteria.then: They see the project's Fieldwire floor plans and can import one as a design

acceptance_criteria.when: Its floor plan gets a new version in Fieldwire
acceptance_criteria.then: Project admins get an email and the Track3D design stays as it was

requirements.title: Fieldwire punch lists appear as notes on the design
requirements.statement: Imported Fieldwire punch lists show as notes on the design, can be filtered as Fieldwire notes, and show the last sync time in the Notes panel. A manual sync option refreshes one design's punch lists. If the user later loses access to the Fieldwire project, imported notes are kept and the user is asked to relink.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user viewing a design imported from Fieldwire
acceptance_criteria.when: They choose manual sync in the Notes panel
acceptance_criteria.then: That design's punch-list notes refresh and the last sync time updates

acceptance_criteria.given: A project whose linking user lost access to the Fieldwire project
acceptance_criteria.then: Existing imported notes stay and the user is asked to relink

requirements.title: A new Fieldwire task becomes a note on each matching imported design
requirements.statement: When Fieldwire reports a new task with a floor plan and a position, Track3D adds an Issue note to every active design imported from that floor plan that has task import turned on and whose saved filters match the task. The task's position is converted onto the design's sheet. Updated tasks update their notes.

acceptance_criteria.given: Two active designs imported from the same Fieldwire floor plan, one with task import on
acceptance_criteria.when: Fieldwire reports a new task on that floor plan with a position
acceptance_criteria.then: Only the design with task import on gets an Issue note at the converted position

acceptance_criteria.given: A design whose saved Fieldwire filters exclude the task's status
acceptance_criteria.then: No note is added to that design

requirements.title: How often Fieldwire tasks reach Track3D
requirements.statement: The PRD asks for task sync every 15 minutes, a daily automatic punch-list import and a manual sync. The code pushes each task as Fieldwire reports it, through the webhook.

dispute.summary: SRC-034 FR-001 and NFR-001 say every 15 minutes, FR-005 says daily, and FR-006 adds manual sync. The code reacts to Fieldwire webhook events as they arrive. Product to pick the promise (DEC-050).

acceptance_criteria.given: A task created in Fieldwire on an imported floor plan
acceptance_criteria.then: (Current behaviour) The note is created straight away rather than on a schedule

requirements.title: A Fieldwire key is checked with Fieldwire before it is saved
requirements.statement: Saving a Fieldwire API key first exchanges it with Fieldwire for an access token. A key Fieldwire rejects is refused and not saved. An accepted key is stored encrypted.
